description: Auto-Learning (Claudeception Integration) - Automatic skill extraction from Ralph iterations for cross-project learning

userStories.title: Add skill extraction instructions to prompt.md
userStories.description: As a Ralph iteration, I need instructions on when and how to evaluate for skill extraction so I can output candidates when quality gates pass.
acceptanceCriteria: Add 'Skill Extraction (Claudeception)' section to prompt.md
Document all 4 quality gates (non-obvious, reusable, verified, specific trigger)
Document when to extract vs when NOT to extract
Document the 3 categories (error-resolutions, patterns, workflows)
Document the <<<SKILL_CANDIDATE>>> output format with all required fields
Section is 60 lines or less

userStories.title: Add write_skill_candidate function to ralph.sh
userStories.description: As ralph.sh, I need to detect and parse skill candidate blocks from iteration output so skills can be written to disk.
acceptanceCriteria: Add SKILL_DIR constant pointing to ~/.claude/skills/ralph-learnings
Add write_skill_candidate() function that extracts category, name, description, content
Function validates all required fields are present
Function validates category is in allowed list (error-resolutions, patterns, workflows)
Function skips gracefully if block malformed or missing
Function skips if skill with same name already exists (no overwrites)
Script passes shellcheck

userStories.title: Write skill files with correct format
userStories.description: As ralph.sh, I need to write extracted skills with proper SKILL.md format so Claude Code can discover and load them.
acceptanceCriteria: Create category subdirectory if it doesn't exist
Write skill file with YAML frontmatter (only name and description fields)
Description preserved exactly as provided (should start with 'Use when...')
Content body preserved with all sections
Append Origin section with extracted timestamp, project name, and story ID
Output success message: '✓ Extracted skill: [category]/[name].md'
Script passes shellcheck
userStories.notes: Already implemented in US-002 - file writing logic was part of write_skill_candidate function

userStories.title: Integrate extraction into main loop
userStories.description: As ralph.sh, I need to call skill extraction after successful iterations so discoveries are captured automatically.
acceptanceCriteria: Call write_skill_candidate after record_metrics 'success' line
Pass OUTPUT and STORY_ID to function
Extraction runs on every successful iteration (no flag needed)
Extraction failures don't break the main loop
Script passes shellcheck
userStories.notes: Depends on US-002 and US-003 (function must be complete)

userStories.title: Test bash extraction with valid input
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to verify the extraction function works correctly with well-formed input.
acceptanceCriteria: Create test script scripts/test-skill-extraction.sh
Test extracts all fields correctly from valid skill candidate block
Test creates correct directory structure
Test writes valid YAML frontmatter
Test preserves multiline content correctly
All assertions pass
Test script passes shellcheck
userStories.notes: Depends on US-004 (full implementation must exist to test)

userStories.title: Test bash extraction edge cases
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to verify the extraction function handles edge cases gracefully.
acceptanceCriteria: Test: missing skill candidate block returns 0, no output
Test: malformed block (missing fields) shows warning, no file created
Test: invalid category shows warning, no file created
Test: duplicate skill name shows warning, existing file not overwritten
All assertions pass
Test script passes shellcheck
userStories.notes: Depends on US-005 (test infrastructure must exist)

userStories.title: Document auto-learning in CLAUDE.md
userStories.description: As a developer reading CLAUDE.md, I need to understand the auto-learning feature so I know how it works.
acceptanceCriteria: Add 'Skill Extraction (Claudeception)' subsection under Key Patterns
Document quality gates (brief summary)
Document output format reference
Document storage location and categories
Note cross-project learning benefit
Section is 20 lines or less

userStories.title: End-to-end integration test
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to verify the complete flow works from iteration output to skill file on disk.
acceptanceCriteria: Run a mock Ralph iteration with skill candidate in output
Verify skill file created at correct path
Verify skill file has valid YAML frontmatter
Verify skill file content matches input
Verify Origin section populated correctly
Clean up test artifacts after test
Test script passes shellcheck
userStories.notes: Final verification - depends on all previous stories
